# Execute the reviewed optional-call semantics both natively and after export.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/option_chain_error.lgo option_chain_error/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/option_chain_error.out option_chain_error/expected.txt
cd option_chain_error
logos run .
cmp stdout expected.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
env GOROOT=$UPROOT1272
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE run .
cmp stdout ../expected.txt
env GOROOT=$TESTGO_GOROOT
cd ../..

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/option_chain_try_stmt.lgo option_chain_try_stmt/main.lgo
